data.subject: invoice processing at Zipline
data.body:
Hi Mac,

Zipline moved into a larger headquarters in preparation for an expansion of its drone delivery operations. Having led GTM finance at Zipline before your current role, you know that expansion usually generates a surge in vendor contracts and invoice processing. Uber Freight cut invoice audit time from 1 day to 1 hour with Zamp's AI agents.

Open to a 20-minute call next week?

[Your name]
